title: Elliot Miles
text: I’m a PhD researcher at the University of Liverpool, studying how global warming affects the reproductive success of Andean trees. My work follows trees from seed to seedling with fieldwork in the tropical Andes of Ecuador.

title: Elliot Miles
text:
Education
PhD, University of Liverpool | 2025 – present | Understanding reproductive success to evaluate the impact of global warming on Andean trees
MRes Advanced Biological Sciences, University of Liverpool | 2020 – 2021 | Environmental, genetic and phenotypic drivers of forest resilience to climate change
BSc Ecology & Conservation Biology, University of Sheffield | 2016 – 2019 |
